en.headline: Hong Kong Creative & Design Exhibition opens at HKCEC as part of MEGA SHOW
en.dek: More than 300 creators from across Asia gather in Wan Chai until Friday for the new section covering cultural brands, IP licensing and trendy toys, with onsite registration at HK$20.
body: The Hong Kong Creative & Design Exhibition opened on Tuesday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, running concurrently with the 33rd MEGA SHOW until 23 October.

Organisers said the section brings together more than 300 international creators from mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, Korea and Southeast Asia. It focuses on three areas: cultural and creative brands that turn design into commercial products, IP licensing for characters and designs, and trendy toys from concept to collectibles.

Visitors can attend selected lectures and workshops during the four-day event, including sessions on AI toy launches, OEM and ODM customisation, oracle bone script zodiac designs, and Zhangjiajie cultural products. Online pre-registration for free entry has closed; visitors must register onsite and pay a HK$20 admission fee.

MEGA SHOW itself is a long-running Asian sourcing fair organised by Comasia Limited. The creative exhibition is presented as a new addition aimed at connecting designers and IP holders with manufacturers and buyers already attending the larger show.

zh.headline: 香港文創設計展於會展開幕 與MEGA SHOW同期舉行
zh.dek: 逾300位來自亞洲各地的創作者齊聚灣仔，至周五展出文創品牌、IP授權及潮流玩具，入場需現場登記繳付20元。
body: 香港文創設計展周二在灣仔香港會議展覽中心開幕，與第33屆MEGA SHOW同期舉行，至10月23日結束。
主辦單位表示，展區匯聚超過300位來自中國大陸、香港、台灣、日本、韓國及東南亞的國際創作者，聚焦三大範疇：將設計轉為商業產品的文創品牌、角色與設計的IP授權，以及從概念到收藏品的潮流玩具。
四天展期設有精選講座及工作坊，包括AI潮玩新品發布、OEM及ODM定制方案、甲骨文十二生肖及張家界文創產品等。網上預先登記免費入場已截止，訪客需在現場登記並繳付20港元入場費。
MEGA SHOW本身是由Comasia Limited主辦的長期亞洲採購展。文創設計展是新增部分，旨在讓設計師及IP持有人與已出席大型展會的製造商和買家對接。
